tools.name: song_list
tools.description: List the songs (audio files) currently in the local song library.

summary.zh: 列出曲库里现有的翻唱音频文件。
summary.en: List the audio files in the local song library.

tools.name: song_send
tools.description: Take one song from the local library and return it as a [blob] attachment handle. After that, call qq_draft with that handle in its voice field to send a QQ voice bar.

name.description: File name or a distinctive part of it, e.g. "see-you-again" or "大鱼".

summary.zh: 从曲库取出一首歌的音频，回执带句柄；再用 qq_draft 的 voice 发送。
summary.en: Return one library song as an audio blob handle, ready for qq_draft voice.
